name: $T_{C} = \frac{5}{9}(T_{F} - 32)$
content: Relationship between Celsius temperature and Fahrenheit temperature
e: Relationship between Celsius temperature and Fahrenheit temperature is written $T_{C} = \frac{5}{9}(T_{F} - 32)$. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.

name: $T_{C} + 273 = T_{K}$
content: Relationship between Celsius temperature and Kelvin temperature
e: Relationship between Celsius temperature and Kelvin temperature is written $T_{C} + 273 = T_{K}$. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.

name: $\Delta l = \alpha l \Delta T$
content: Change in length due to linear expansion
e: Change in length due to linear expansion is written $\Delta l = \alpha l \Delta T$. Each symbol stands for a quantity from this chapter.

name: $\alpha = \frac{\Delta l}{l} \times \frac{1}{\Delta T}$
e: Coefficient of linear expansion is written $\alpha = \frac{\Delta l}{l} \times \frac{1}{\Delta T}$. Most objects grow when they warm because the molecules move harder.

name: $l' = l(1 + \alpha \Delta T)$
content: Length of the object at an increased temperature
e: Length of the object at an increased temperature is written $l' = l(1 + \alpha \Delta T)$. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.
